versions.changelog:
- Added a "Related Skills" section with commands for monitoring large transactions, managing wallets, and claiming HBAR bounties.
- No other changes to functionality or API instructions.

Initial release — query Hedera public blockchain data via the Mirror Node REST API, no authentication required.

- Check account HBAR and token balances
- Fetch token metadata and holdings
- View NFTs owned by an account
- Retrieve recent account transactions
- Get network status and Hedera token market data (via SaucerSwap)
- Public endpoints for both mainnet and testnet included
